frame.name: Rapid-Fire Glaive

origins.name: Collective Purpose
origins.description: Gain bonus range and handling when near allies. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate. The effect scales with the number of nearby allies.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

enhanced.name: Disruption Break
enhanced.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Grave Robber
enhanced.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves. Improves handling.

perks.name: Immovable Object
perks.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.

enhanced.name: Immovable Object
enhanced.description: Dealing ranged damage grants substantially increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Replenishing Aegis
enhanced.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves. Shortens delay between activations.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Dimensional Shift
perks.description: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a Void Overshield.

enhanced.name: Dimensional Shift
enhanced.description: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a higher value Void Overshield.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

enhanced.name: Close to Melee
enhanced.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

enhanced.name: Unstoppable Force
enhanced.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Action
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

flavor: Prepare yourself. Things get weirder from here on out.
